summary: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin adapter for litkit — academic literature search, citation audit, and download tools. Root npm package of the polyglot litkit-search monorepo, so `dsh plugin add github:bpc-oss/litkit-search` installs the adapter directly.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Primary purpose is an agent-facing scholarly literature utility: a DeepSeek Harness plugin adapter that enables search, retrieval, and citation-audit workflows over many academic sources. Conservatively, capabilities include multi-source bibliographic search, PDF/supplement download, manuscript reference verification, result export, and workflow automation. A human check is needed due optional paywall-bypass-style fallback download paths.
